description: Checks how strong the grounds to appeal a parking fine or parking charge look, from yes/no answers (signs, markings, payment machine, notice details, valid ticket or permit, owner or keeper, mitigating circumstances, evidence). Returns likely grounds, where to send the appeal in that country, a deadline note and links to the Appeal Calculator and sample letters. Use this when someone asks about appealing, disputing or challenging a parking fine, ticket, citation, PCN or private parking charge, or about their chances of winning. All inputs are optional: pass what the driver has said and the country. General information, not legal advice.

country.description: Two-letter country code where the fine was issued (AU, US, GB, CA, NZ, IE or other).

details_correct.description: Are the registration, place, date and offense on the notice correct?

were_you_the_owner_or_keeper.description: Was the person the owner or registered keeper at the time?
